title: Choose the end-to-end tests a release needs
statement: As a developer, I can get the end-to-end tests that prove the stories a release affects, so I can sleep at night without paying for the full suite.
overview: This narrows the existing selection to the catalog. As there, a changed story brings in the tests for all its criteria and not only the criterion that changed, because tests are not assumed to be interchangeable.

acceptance_criteria.statement: `release tests` lists every catalog entry that verifies a criterion of a story the range or a hand link reaches, once each, even if its own code did not change.
An entry whose own code changed in the range is listed too.
Each listed test names the stories and criteria that selected it.
Retired and deprecated test cases are not listed.
The output says how many tests are selected and how many are in the catalog.
It does not drop a test because another seems to cover the same thing.
